pressures.source_evidence: record human_capability_summary; cHardwareCPU Inst_HeadCopy; cHardwareBase Divide_CheckViable; cPhenotype DivideReset; Apto Integrated scheduler; cPopulation PositionOffspring
pressures.condition: the world executes many programs a few instructions at a time; a program persists only by producing a copy of itself that passes a plausibility gate; each copied symbol is corrupted with a fixed probability; the share of execution a lineage receives is proportional to a score that starts at its length and multiplies when its inputs and outputs satisfy functions the world names
pressures.resource_or_constraint: instruction slots per world step; cells (a copy needs an empty or killed cell); a mutation rate per copied symbol
pressures.failure_condition: no lineage replicates within the run (the ancestor is lost), or the population collapses to minimal replicators that compute nothing
pressures.world_punishes: long genomes (more to copy per cycle) and computation that does not pay in score; slow copiers under replacement death
pressures.world_rewards: lineages whose copy is fast and accurate enough AND whose extra instructions earn multiplicative score
pressures.observable_consequence: fraction of runs in which any named function appears by generation G; genome length and per-site mutation load over time; time to the highest-value function as the reward ladder's base (ADD vs MULT vs POW) is varied
pressures.vacuity_condition: no copy error (nothing varies), or unlimited CPU and space (no competition), or a score independent of computation
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a program that divides without copying (closed by the copied-fraction gate); a world that rewards length alone
pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed the full score directly (bonus injected) must dominate the population within a few generations without computing anything -- if it does not, the scheduler is not reading merit; a non-replicating organism must vanish within one replacement cycle -- if it persists, death is not replacement
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: experimental digital evolution (Adami, Ofria, Brown; Avida 1993-)

pressures.condition: the world names a set of functions with values; an organism's score is the composition (add, multiply, or 2^value) of the rewards of every function it performs; complex functions are built from simpler ones the same programs already perform
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the score is the only lever on CPU share; the functions cost instructions to perform
pressures.failure_condition: the most complex function never appears because its stepping stones are not rewarded, or because rewards for stepping stones saturate
pressures.world_punishes: a ladder whose intermediate rungs pay nothing
pressures.world_rewards: a ladder whose rungs compound
pressures.observable_consequence: appearance rate of the top function across reward compositions (Lenski et al. 2003 shape: EQU evolves only when simpler functions are rewarded)
pressures.vacuity_condition: one function, or additive rewards so small that score is dominated by length
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: rewarding the top function directly at a value that dwarfs length
pressures.cheat_control: a world rewarding only the top function must show it evolving rarely or never; the same world with the compounding ladder must show it often: if the difference is not visible, the ladder is not the operative pressure
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: evolution of complex features (Lenski, Ofria, Pennock, Adami 2003)

pressures.condition: N cells; a newborn takes a cell and its occupant dies; the cell is chosen at random (well-mixed), by age (eldest), or by neighbourhood (spatial); no organism dies for being unfit -- it dies because a neighbour reproduced
pressures.resource_or_constraint: cells
pressures.failure_condition: a lineage that reproduces slowly is replaced before it reproduces even when its score is high (score buys cycles, not immunity)
pressures.world_punishes: long gestation
pressures.world_rewards: short gestation relative to neighbours; in spatial worlds, local clustering
pressures.observable_consequence: lineage persistence vs gestation time under each placement rule; spatial correlation of genotypes under neighbourhood placement vs well-mixed
pressures.vacuity_condition: more cells than organisms (nobody is replaced)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world that never fills
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given a cell that is excluded from placement must never die and must not spread: the world must show both, or placement is not the death mechanism
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: population structure in digital evolution (Avida birth methods)

pressures.source_evidence: _wait_gen.py; _jitter.py; _sync.py; Brooker 2015 as cited in the body
pressures.condition: N organisms hit a shared service that fails transiently; each decides when to retry; the score is time to recovery, total wasted calls and the peak concurrent retry load; some failures are permanent
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the service's capacity; a wall-clock budget per client
pressures.failure_condition: retries synchronised into a spike (the thundering herd), unbounded retrying of a permanent failure, or recovery slower than the failure's duration
pressures.world_punishes: fixed intervals; no jitter; no give-up
pressures.world_rewards: exponential schedules with full jitter and a give-up rule
pressures.observable_consequence: peak retry load and time-to-recovery for N clients with fixed / exponential / exponential-plus-full-jitter schedules on the same outage trace (Brooker's simulation)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a coordinator that schedules retries (which the world withholds)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism told the outage's end time must retry exactly once at that time; N clients with no jitter must show a load spike at 2^k intervals; full jitter must flatten it: the world must show both

pressures.condition: an organism manages a heap for a program that gives no type information and may hold pointers anywhere in registers, stacks and objects; it must free unreachable memory, never free reachable memory, and keep its own time and the memory it wrongly retains bounded
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the heap; a per-word test budget
pressures.failure_condition: freeing a reachable object (unsafe), or retention/pause growing with heap size
pressures.world_punishes: treating every word as a pointer with no index (unbounded scan); treating none (leaks everything)
pressures.world_rewards: a range filter plus an O(1) block index; black-listing false hits; allocation-proportional triggering
pressures.observable_consequence: bytes falsely retained and GC time fraction vs heap size, on a program that stores random integers in large arrays (the conservative worst case), with black-listing on and off and with the free-space divisor varied
pressures.vacuity_condition: a program that keeps no integers that look like addresses
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a precise collector with compiler cooperation (which the world must withhold)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given precise pointer maps must retain zero false bytes (the bound); with black-listing disabled false retention on the integer-array program must rise; with the divisor at 1 GC time must dominate: the world must show all three
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: memory management for uncooperative languages (Boehm, Demers, Weiser 1988-)

pressures.condition: a stream of conditional decisions arrives faster than their conditions resolve; the organism must guess each one now from bounded memory of past outcomes, and its guesses change what it sees next before the truth arrives; a wrong guess costs a fixed penalty (the flush)
pressures.resource_or_constraint: a few kilobits of state; one cycle per guess
pressures.failure_condition: misprediction rate above the static baseline on real code
pressures.world_punishes: guessing from stale or aliased state; waiting for resolution
pressures.world_rewards: hysteresis, correlation with recent history, a stack for nested returns, and speculative shadow state resynchronised on truth
pressures.observable_consequence: misprediction rate per predictor component on instruction traces with each component disabled (the module's own parameters do this)
pressures.vacuity_condition: branches that are always taken or never taken (static prediction suffices)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an oracle trace
pressures.cheat_control: a predictor fed the resolved outcome one cycle early must mispredict nothing; SUPPORT_BRANCH_PREDICTION = 0 (the body's own control) must show the static rate: the world must show both
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: instruction fetch redirection in a pipelined CPU (biRISC-V, Ultra-Embedded)

pressures.condition: N organisms push data through one queue of bounded size; the queue drops when full; each organism sees only its own acknowledgements and their timing; goodput is rewarded, retransmissions are not
pressures.resource_or_constraint: bottleneck capacity C shared by N; queue length Q; per-organism feedback delayed by one round trip
pressures.failure_condition: aggregate offered load stays above C after drops begin (collapse: goodput -> 0 while the link stays busy with duplicates)
pressures.world_punishes: sending a full window after every timeout; treating a drop as an isolated loss
pressures.world_rewards: an organism that reduces its offered load when its own losses rise and probes upward when they stop
pressures.observable_consequence: aggregate goodput / C as N grows; retransmissions per delivered segment; fairness across the N
pressures.vacuity_condition: N = 1 or C >= sum of the windows (no shared queue)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world that tells the organism C/N directly; fixed-rate senders tuned to C/N offline; a queue that never drops (infinite buffer -> latency instead of loss, a different pressure)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed the exact fair share must reach it with zero retransmissions; the ancestor's policy (window-limited, timer-only backoff) must show the collapse at some N: if the world cannot reproduce the 1986 shape with the ancestor, it is not exerting this pressure
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: reliable byte stream over a shared internet (RFC 793 as implemented in 4.2BSD)

pressures.condition: each request is answered after a delay drawn from an unknown, drifting distribution; the organism must decide when a request is lost; deciding too early wastes capacity, too late wastes time
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one sample per outstanding request at most; coarse clock; no side channel
pressures.failure_condition: spurious retransmissions (timer < delay) or long stalls (timer >> delay)
pressures.world_punishes: both
pressures.world_rewards: an estimator that tracks the mean and the spread and a timer set from both
pressures.observable_consequence: spurious-timeout rate and stall time as the delay distribution's variance is varied
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a timer fixed at the known maximum delay; a world that reveals the delay
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the true delay per request must show zero spurious timeouts and zero stall; the ancestor's mean-only estimator with beta=2 must show spurious timeouts once the variance exceeds the mean: if the world cannot show that difference the pressure is absent
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: retransmission timeout estimation (the 4.2BSD form, before Jacobson 1988)

pressures.source_evidence: tcp_input.c 790-900; tcp_timer.c 147-232; the record's lineage (Fall & Floyd 1996)
pressures.condition: many organisms send through a bottleneck of unknown capacity; the only feedback is ACKs and their absence; a drained pipe costs a round trip of idle capacity; fairness and stability are scored
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the bottleneck's capacity and queue; one RTT of feedback delay
pressures.failure_condition: congestion collapse (goodput falls as load rises), or a single loss costing a timeout-length idle period
pressures.world_punishes: sending the advertised window regardless of loss (4.2BSD); waiting for the timer after a loss (Tahoe without fast retransmit)
pressures.world_rewards: multiplicative decrease on loss, additive increase between losses, retransmission on duplicate-ACK evidence with the window kept full
pressures.observable_consequence: goodput and fairness index of N flows vs offered load, and time-to-recover after a single dropped segment, for the 1983, Tahoe and Reno rules on the same queue
pressures.vacuity_condition: one flow with a known capacity
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: explicit rate signalling from the bottleneck (which the world must withhold)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism told the bottleneck rate must hold it with zero loss; the 1983 rule must collapse under N flows; Tahoe must show the timeout gap on a single loss that Reno closes: the world must show all three

pressures.condition: an organism allocates and frees blocks of varying sizes from a fixed arena; requests are rounded to powers of two; time per operation and metadata size are both scored; large requests must keep succeeding late in the trace
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the arena; a few bits per block of metadata
pressures.failure_condition: a large request fails while total free space would have sufficed (external fragmentation), or an operation costs more than O(log size)
pressures.world_punishes: free lists that scatter small allocations across free subtrees; metadata that grows with the number of live blocks
pressures.world_rewards: a summary per node and a descent that packs into busy subtrees
pressures.observable_consequence: largest satisfiable request after a fixed alloc/free trace, and metadata bytes, vs a naive first-fit buddy (Knuth's) on the same trace
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an arena much larger than the live set
pressures.cheat_control: an organism told the future trace can pack optimally (an upper bound); the naive buddy with the busier-child rule removed (go left always) must show more failures on an adversarial trace: the world must show both

pressures.resource_or_constraint: the node table; the order
pressures.failure_condition: two equal functions stored differently (a missed equivalence), operations exponential in the DAG size, or a size blow-up under a bad order
pressures.world_punishes: tree representations; uncached recursion; a fixed order
pressures.world_rewards: hash-consing, a computed cache, and dynamic reordering

pressures.condition: an organism sees only the ranking of lambda evaluated points per generation; the objective's Hessian is unknown, ill-conditioned and rotated; the budget is function evaluations; the score is evaluations to a target precision across a suite

pressures.failure_condition: evaluations growing with the condition number (an isotropic search), or premature convergence from step-size collapse, or divergence
pressures.world_punishes: fixed step sizes; diagonal-only covariance on rotated problems; success-rule step control on noisy rankings
pressures.world_rewards: a covariance that whitens the selected steps; path-length step control; calibrated stopping

pressures.condition: an organism reads untrusted bytes into a tree; inputs include truncated, over-nested, escape-broken and locale-varying forms; a crash or out-of-bounds read is the failure; valid inputs must parse in linear time and bounded stack
pressures.resource_or_constraint: stack depth; one allocation per node
pressures.failure_condition: any out-of-bounds access, unbounded recursion or leak on failure
pressures.world_punishes: reading past the length; recursing without a cap; allocating before measuring
pressures.world_rewards: per-access bounds predicates; a depth constant; measure-then-allocate

pressures.cheat_control: an organism given a validity oracle must accept exactly the valid inputs at zero crashes; the 1.7 parser with the depth check removed must crash on a 100,000-deep array: the world must show both

pressures.source_evidence: drive.c; agenda.c; record tags production-rules / pattern-matching

pressures.resource_or_constraint: memory for retained partial matches; time per fact change
pressures.failure_condition: re-matching every rule against every fact per cycle (cost R x F^k), or memory blow-up on cross-product joins

pressures.world_rewards: retained, hashed partial matches shared across rules
pressures.observable_consequence: time per cycle vs R and F with the beta memories enabled vs disabled; memory vs join selectivity
pressures.vacuity_condition: one rule or one fact change per run
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world where facts never change

pressures.condition: files written decades ago must be readable byte-for-byte by programs written today; the layout is the contract and no schema exists outside the programs

pressures.failure_condition: a misread field (record: mis-edited amount)
pressures.world_punishes: implicit layouts; encodings that change with the machine
pressures.world_rewards: the layout written in the program, byte-exact, with the encoding named per field

pressures.cheat_control: a program given the layout as data (a copybook) must read the file; if the world rewards it equally to one that guesses the layout from the bytes, format longevity is not being measured

pressures.world_rewards: declared-scale decimal arithmetic and edited output

pressures.source_evidence: essential.py (three classes); tests/test_essential.py as the oracle

pressures.failure_condition: two different values chosen, or a chosen value overwritten after a crash
pressures.world_punishes: proposers that ignore prior acceptances; acceptors that forget promises
pressures.world_rewards: the adoption rule and durable promises
pressures.observable_consequence: count of distinct chosen values over many runs with injected reorderings, losses and restarts (must be exactly one); rounds to resolution
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed leader that never crashes
pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed the chosen value by the world must resolve in one round with zero conflicts; the essential layer with the adoption rule DELETED (a proposer always sends its own value) must show two chosen values under a leader change: the world must show that violation or it is not exerting the safety pressure
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: single-decree consensus (Lamport, Paxos Made Simple)

pressures.condition: the safety mechanism above can livelock; the organism may add timers and a leader to make progress, but any timer may fire falsely

pressures.failure_condition: a false timer produces a second chosen value (safety broken) or permanent dueling (no progress)
pressures.world_punishes: timers that change safety-layer state; windows shorter than message delay
pressures.world_rewards: a layer that only decides WHEN to run the safe protocol

pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world with a global clock
pressures.cheat_control: with a perfect failure detector supplied by the world the organism must resolve in the minimum rounds; with the window set far below the delay the ancestor must show dueling and still exactly one chosen value: both must be visible

pressures.condition: symbols arrive one at a time and each must be emitted before the next is seen; the receiver has no header, no table and no second pass; the score is output length

pressures.failure_condition: output longer than input, or a receiver that desynchronises

pressures.world_rewards: an organism whose model after k symbols is a deterministic function of those k symbols
pressures.observable_consequence: compressed/uncompressed ratio as a function of input length on stationary and on drifting sources; desynchronisation count under injected errors
pressures.vacuity_condition: a source with a known fixed distribution (a static code wins) or a two-pass budget

pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed the true source distribution must beat the ancestor on a stationary source and lose to it on a source that drifts after 10^4 symbols: if the world cannot show both, it is not exerting the one-pass/adaptivity pressure

pressures.condition: a structure orders items by counts that increase one at a time; after each increment the ordering invariant must hold before the next item is processed; repairs cost time per level

pressures.failure_condition: an invariant violation that goes unrepaired (a non-optimal code, or worse a decoder mismatch)

pressures.world_rewards: a repair that touches only the path from the changed item to the root

pressures.trivial_shortcuts: periodic full rebuild with the invariant checked only at rebuild time
pressures.cheat_control: an organism that rebuilds fully after every increment must show zero violations at maximal cost; an organism that never repairs must show violations after the first out-of-order increment: the world must see both

pressures.condition: an organism builds a dictionary from what it has seen; once full it cannot change; the source's statistics may drift; the organism sees only its own compression ratio, in chunks

pressures.world_rewards: a reset rule that fires on real drift and not on noise

pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world that announces the drift

pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: adaptive dictionary compression with reset (Unix compress 4.x)

pressures.condition: many senders share a link whose only feedback is a dropped packet, observed one round trip late; over-sending collapses everyone's useful throughput
pressures.resource_or_constraint: bottleneck capacity; one RTT of delay before any signal
pressures.failure_condition: congestion collapse (record: 1986)

pressures.world_rewards: backing off on a loss and re-growing at a rate that neither idles the link nor starves neighbours
pressures.observable_consequence: throughput per flow, loss rate, convergence time between flows
pressures.vacuity_condition: a single sender on an uncontended link; or a link that never drops

pressures.cheat_control: a sender that reads the bottleneck capacity directly from the world must reach the utilisation that the loss-signal-only sender can only approach; if it cannot, the world does not reward the capability

pressures.condition: the bottleneck buffer holds many seconds of data, so loss arrives long after queueing delay has grown; a loss-driven sender fills the buffer and every flow's latency rises

pressures.failure_condition: bufferbloat: throughput fine, latency ruined
pressures.world_punishes: inflight beyond bandwidth*min_rtt
pressures.world_rewards: an estimate of the pipe (rate and floor delay) used instead of waiting for loss
pressures.observable_consequence: queueing delay under load; min_rtt drift
pressures.vacuity_condition: shallow buffers (loss and delay rise together)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed low rate; a sender that never probes for more
pressures.cheat_control: a sender given the true bandwidth and propagation delay must show low delay at full utilisation in the world; otherwise the world's reward is not measuring the capability

pressures.condition: a middlebox admits traffic at a fixed long-term rate and drops bursts above it; a sender that probes upward is punished with a burst of loss every probe
pressures.resource_or_constraint: an external rate cap invisible except through loss timing

pressures.world_punishes: probing above the cap
pressures.world_rewards: inferring the cap from two agreeing loss-bounded intervals and holding at it
pressures.observable_consequence: loss rate vs sending rate shows a knee at the cap
pressures.vacuity_condition: no enforcer, or an enforcer with a bucket larger than the probe
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a sender that halves on every loss (Reno) finds a rate below the cap but oscillates; the world must reward holding AT the cap
pressures.cheat_control: a sender told the cap must hold it with near-zero loss; if the world does not distinguish that from the oscillating sender, the pressure is not being measured

pressures.condition: the organism's work product is linked structure in a fixed pool of identical cells; structure is shared and cyclic; the organism cannot know when a cell dies; the pool must be recycled or the computation halts
pressures.resource_or_constraint: pool size; a bounded scratch area for whatever reclamation needs (the ancestor's PDL)
pressures.failure_condition: halt on exhaustion with live data still small (a leak), or reclaiming a live cell (corruption)
pressures.world_punishes: both; and thrashing (collecting often for little yield)
pressures.world_rewards: reclamation that is exact from a declared root set and cheap in scratch space
pressures.observable_consequence: cells reclaimed per collection vs live cells; collections per 10^6 conses; corruption detected by a reachability oracle
pressures.vacuity_condition: a pool larger than total allocation (never collect) or acyclic unshared data (reference counts suffice)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: reference counting when the world has no cycles; a world that exposes lifetimes
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given a lifetime oracle must reclaim every dead cell at zero scratch cost; an organism that never reclaims must halt at pool size: the world must separate them and must contain cycles or the pressure is a different one
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: automatic storage reclamation (McCarthy 1960, as coded 1961)

pressures.condition: the reclaimer sees only registered ranges and a stack; any organism component that keeps a pointer elsewhere across an allocation must register the place
pressures.resource_or_constraint: registration cost per temporary; scanning cost per registered word
pressures.failure_condition: a dangling pointer after a collection
pressures.world_punishes: unregistered temporaries (corruption) and over-registration (scan cost, retention)
pressures.world_rewards: a discipline that registers exactly the live temporaries
pressures.observable_consequence: corruptions per collection under a mutator that allocates during computation; scan words per collection
pressures.vacuity_condition: no allocation between taking a pointer and using it
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: register the whole address space (conservative scan)
pressures.cheat_control: a mutator that registers nothing must corrupt on the first collection during a hold; one that registers everything must show the scan cost: if the world cannot see either, the root-declaration pressure is absent
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: root registration for a non-moving collector

pressures.condition: the process or host can die between any two writes; the medium may tear a multi-page write; on reopen there is no log to replay
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no write-ahead log; one file
pressures.failure_condition: a torn write corrupts the tree (record)

pressures.world_rewards: never overwriting reachable state and switching the root atomically after a sync
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's oracle after a kill between put and commit
pressures.vacuity_condition: no crashes; or a medium with atomic multi-page writes

pressures.cheat_control: a store told when the crash will happen must always recover; if the world scores it no better than a store that corrupts on a torn meta, the world is not injecting crashes at the right instants

pressures.condition: many processes read while one writes; reads must be consistent snapshots and must not slow the writer or each other
pressures.resource_or_constraint: shared memory; no coordination on the read path
pressures.failure_condition: a reader observes a page mid-change (record) or waits on the writer

pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a global lock (consistent, serialised); the world must reward concurrency
pressures.cheat_control: a reader given a private frozen copy must see a consistent snapshot; a world that does not detect torn reads on the naive store is not measuring isolation

pressures.condition: copy-on-write leaves the old page behind; without reclamation the file grows without bound; with premature reclamation a reader dereferences reused bytes
pressures.resource_or_constraint: disk space vs reader lifetime
pressures.failure_condition: unbounded growth (long reader) or corruption (early reuse)
pressures.world_punishes: both
pressures.world_rewards: a version-stamped free list gated by the oldest live snapshot
pressures.observable_consequence: file size vs reader lifetime distribution
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never free (bounded workloads only)
pressures.cheat_control: a store told every reader's exit time exactly must reclaim eagerly and never corrupt; if the world rewards a never-free store equally on a long run, it is not charging for space

pressures.condition: an organism holds C entries; keys arrive in a stream with temporal locality; a miss costs a fetch; per-access time must not grow with C or with the stream length
pressures.resource_or_constraint: C slots; O(1) per access
pressures.failure_condition: hit rate far below Belady's offline optimum on locality-bearing streams, or per-access cost growing with C
pressures.world_punishes: FIFO and random eviction on reuse-heavy streams; LRU on scans larger than C
pressures.world_rewards: recency ordering; scan resistance if the world includes scans
pressures.observable_consequence: hit rate vs Belady's MIN on a Zipf stream, on a cyclic scan of length > C, and on their interleaving
pressures.vacuity_condition: C at least the number of distinct keys
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a stream with no reuse (every policy scores zero)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the future (Belady) bounds the score; random eviction bounds it below on the Zipf stream; on the scan stream LRU must equal random (its known failure) so a scan-resistant organism is distinguishable: the world must show all three

pressures.condition: the organism maps any input to n bits; an adversary who knows the map fully tries to produce two inputs with the same output (collision) or an input for a given output (preimage); the organism's cost per input bit is bounded
pressures.resource_or_constraint: n bits of state; a few operations per input word; the design is public
pressures.failure_condition: a collision found in far fewer than 2^(n/2) trials
pressures.world_punishes: linear diffusion, weak nonlinearity, message-independent schedules
pressures.world_rewards: mixing that resists differential cancellation
pressures.observable_consequence: trials to first collision under a differential search vs the birthday bound; MD5's own history (2^64 -> 2^24) is the measured failure
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world where the adversary cannot read the design
pressures.cheat_control: an organism that is a random oracle (a world-supplied lookup) must show the birthday bound; MD5 must show the known 2^24 differential shortcut: if the world cannot distinguish them, it is not exerting the adversarial pressure
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: cryptographic message digest (Rivest 1992; broken Wang & Yu 2004)

pressures.condition: a decision tree of 2^n leaves; a failed branch's cause usually involves few variables and recurs elsewhere in the tree

pressures.failure_condition: re-exploring the same dead sub-space; or drowning in remembered clauses
pressures.world_punishes: forgetting why a branch failed; keeping everything
pressures.world_rewards: extracting a small reason, jumping back past irrelevant decisions, and forgetting reasons that stop being used
pressures.observable_consequence: conflicts / decisions / propagations per instance (the record's cross-solver comparison)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a lookup table of solved instances (the world must present unseen instances)
pressures.cheat_control: a solver given the satisfying assignment must finish with zero conflicts; one given the refutation clauses must finish near-instantly; if the world cannot tell, it is not measuring search

pressures.condition: no static measure of a variable predicts where conflicts will come from; the search's own recent conflicts are the only signal, and it drifts
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one heuristic evaluation per decision
pressures.failure_condition: a stale order that keeps choosing variables irrelevant to the current conflicts

pressures.world_rewards: an order driven by recent conflict participation with geometric forgetting
pressures.observable_consequence: decisions to solution with var_decay = 0.95 vs a static order (var_decay < 0 in this body)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: random order with restarts
pressures.cheat_control: a heuristic told the variables of the final refutation must beat VSIDS; if it does not, the world's instances do not reward focus

pressures.condition: an organism searches assignments for a CNF with millions of clauses; a wrong early decision can cost the whole budget; the same sub-failures recur across branches; propagation must be cheap per assignment

pressures.failure_condition: timeouts on instances solvable by learning and restarts; propagation cost growing with clause length or with backtracking; a learnt database that starves propagation

pressures.world_rewards: watched literals, first-UIP learning with backjumping, activity-based decisions, bounded learnt sets, restart schedules
pressures.observable_consequence: instances solved within a time budget on a standard set (SAT competition families) with each policy replaced by its naive predecessor one at a time

pressures.condition: data arrive as vectors with no labels and no target; a fixed small set of prototypes must cover them so that similar inputs land on nearby prototypes

pressures.failure_condition: prototypes collapse onto one region (dead cells) or the grid folds (twisted map)

pressures.world_rewards: low quantisation error AND low topographic error together

pressures.vacuity_condition: as many prototypes as samples (each sample gets its own cell)

pressures.condition: the process has two regimes (coarse ordering, fine convergence) and no observable tells it which one it is in; the only control is a decay schedule against a budget known in advance
pressures.resource_or_constraint: max_iter fixed before training
pressures.failure_condition: too fast a decay freezes a twisted map; too slow a decay never converges
pressures.world_punishes: schedules mismatched to the data's structure
pressures.world_rewards: a schedule (or a self-measured proxy) that spends the budget on ordering first
pressures.observable_consequence: final topographic error as a function of the decay law
pressures.vacuity_condition: a budget so large that any decay works
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: run forever; a world must charge for iterations
pressures.cheat_control: a run given the ordering/convergence boundary as an oracle must beat every fixed schedule; otherwise the world's reward does not depend on the schedule

pressures.condition: an organism minimises ||F(x)|| (or solves F(x) = 0) where each F is expensive; the linear model is good only locally; the start may be far from the solution; the score is evaluations to a tolerance and robustness to bad starts
pressures.resource_or_constraint: function evaluations; a fixed QR per Jacobian
pressures.failure_condition: divergence from a poor start (pure Gauss-Newton), or evaluations wasted on a Jacobian that has not changed
pressures.world_punishes: full steps regardless of model quality; re-evaluating the Jacobian every iteration
pressures.world_rewards: a trust radius adapted by actual/predicted reduction; secant updates with a failure-triggered refresh
pressures.observable_consequence: function evaluations and success rate over the More-Garbow-Hillstrom problem set (the ex/ drivers) for LM vs Gauss-Newton, and hybrid vs finite-difference Newton, from the standard and 10x starts
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a start within the Newton basin
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the exact Hessian must reach the tolerance in the fewest iterations; Gauss-Newton without a region must diverge on some 10x starts; the hybrid with re-evaluation every step must use ~n times more evaluations at the same success: the world must show all three
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: nonlinear least squares and equations (More, Garbow, Hillstrom 1980)

pressures.condition: the world's state evolves under a rule whose fastest mode decays 10^6-10^10 times faster than the slow behaviour of interest; the organism must report the slow behaviour to a stated tolerance within a bounded number of evaluations of the rule
pressures.resource_or_constraint: a step/evaluation budget (the ancestor's MXSTEP=500 per call) and a tolerance; the rule's derivative is available but its Jacobian is expensive
pressures.failure_condition: budget exhausted before the horizon (the ancestor's ISTATE=-1) or a reported answer outside tolerance
pressures.world_punishes: taking steps at the fast time scale; reporting an answer that drifts from the slow solution
pressures.world_rewards: an organism whose step is bounded by the slow behaviour, not by the fast mode's stability limit
pressures.observable_consequence: evaluations used vs tolerance achieved on the same problem across stiffness ratios (the record's Robertson-type entry point)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a problem with one time scale, or a budget so large that the fast scale can be resolved
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed tiny step with an unlimited budget; reading the analytic slow manifold if the world exposes it; a lookup of the answer
pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed the exact solution must be scored as passing the tolerance at zero evaluations, and a fixed-step explicit organism must be scored as exhausting the budget at stiffness ratio 10^6: if the world cannot separate those two the pressure is not present

pressures.condition: an organism may build a local linear model of the world's rule at a cost of N evaluations, and each step's inner solve is cheap given the model; the model decays in usefulness as the state moves
pressures.resource_or_constraint: evaluation budget; the model's cost is N times a step's cost
pressures.failure_condition: rebuilding every step (budget) or never rebuilding (inner iteration diverges)
pressures.world_punishes: both extremes
pressures.world_rewards: a refresh policy that reads its own convergence behaviour
pressures.observable_consequence: rebuilds per 100 steps vs inner-iteration failures per 100 steps
pressures.vacuity_condition: the model is free, or the rule is linear so the model never drifts
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed rebuild period tuned to the test problem
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given a free exact model must show zero inner failures and zero rebuild cost; a policy that rebuilds every step must be scored as spending N-fold budget: the world must price the rebuild or the pressure is absent

pressures.condition: an organism chooses its own step/resolution from an error signal it computes; changes are costly (rescaling, invalidated estimates) and the error signal is noisy at the step scale
pressures.resource_or_constraint: each change costs a rescale and a hold-off during which estimates are unreliable
pressures.failure_condition: oscillating resolution (step up, fail, step down, ...) that wastes the budget
pressures.world_punishes: a high change count per accepted step
pressures.world_rewards: hysteresis and hold-off that still track real changes in the solution's smoothness
pressures.observable_consequence: changes per accepted step and rejected steps per accepted step on a problem whose smoothness varies (a known transient)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a constant-smoothness problem where one step size is right throughout
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never change the step (fails the tracking half); change only downward
pressures.cheat_control: a controller fed the exact optimal step sequence must score zero rejections; a controller with hysteresis disabled must show more changes on the same problem: if the world cannot see the difference it is not measuring chatter

pressures.condition: the mapping from regressor to target is unknown and changes over time; each sample arrives once; the estimate must move enough to follow and little enough not to chase noise
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one pass; O(n) or O(n^2) per sample; a step-size constant chosen blind
pressures.failure_condition: divergence (step too large) or lag (step too small) -- the record's failure condition
pressures.world_punishes: a fixed step for a non-stationary plant
pressures.world_rewards: a step that reads the input scale and the recent error correlation
pressures.observable_consequence: tap error vs time across a plant switch (the record's entry point)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a stationary plant with unlimited samples (any small step wins)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: batch least squares on all data (correct, not online; the world must forbid revisiting)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter told the plant's switch times and true taps must show zero error after each switch; if the world scores it equal to LMS at a mu near the stability bound, tracking is not being measured
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: system identification, echo cancellation, equalisation

pressures.condition: occasional huge errors (impulsive noise) dominate a squared-error gradient and throw the weights
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no knowledge of which samples are outliers
pressures.failure_condition: weights jump on each impulse
pressures.world_punishes: linear-in-e updates
pressures.world_rewards: bounded error nonlinearities (sign, tanh, correntropy kernels)
pressures.observable_consequence: tap error under Gaussian vs impulsive noise for LMS vs SSLMS/LLNCOSH/GMCC
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: clip the error (a crude f(e); the world should allow it)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter told which samples are impulses and skipping them must beat every f(e); if not, the world's noise is not impulsive

pressures.condition: regressor components are correlated; the error surface is a narrow valley; a first-order step converges at the rate of the smallest eigenvalue
pressures.resource_or_constraint: per-sample compute (O(n) vs O(n^2))
pressures.failure_condition: slow convergence on coloured input
pressures.world_punishes: first-order steps
pressures.world_rewards: whitening (RLS) or projection onto recent inputs (AP), paid in compute
pressures.observable_consequence: convergence time vs input eigenvalue spread for LMS vs RLS vs AP
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: pre-whiten offline (needs the statistics the pressure hides)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter given the true autocorrelation must converge in ~n steps; if the world cannot separate it from LMS, the input is white
